root@e5a8416a696e:/app# cat > generate_digit.py << 'EOF'
> import numpy as np
> from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
>
> def generate_digit(digit, size=28):
>     img = Image.new('L', (size, size), color=255)
>     draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
>     if digit == 3:
>         draw.rectangle([20, 20, 26, 26], fill=0)
>         draw.rectangle([10, 30, 16, 36], fill=0)
>         draw.line([12, 28, 22, 28], fill=0, width=2)
>     else:
>         draw.rectangle([0, 0, size, size], fill=0)
>     img.save('test.png', 'PNG')
>     print(f'Generated test.png with digit {digit}')
>
> if __name__ == '__main__':
>     generate_digit(3)
> EOF
